description: Events like this one. Up to 4 upcoming events like this one ("More like this" on the event page), never including the event itself: the same top-level crafts (a craft's child crafts included), or the same event type when the event has no craft; within 100 miles of the event, nearest first (250 miles when that finds fewer than 2); other online events anywhere, soonest first, for an online event; the event's state, soonest first, for an in-person event without a map point; over the next 90 days. An event with neither a craft nor a type gets an empty list. A hidden, cancelled or unknown slug is a 404.
